title: docs(ui-merge): fold objectui.org into objectstack docs, K3 — generate the component reference for all 106 authorable components from sdui.manifest.json, with a drift check
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). In the "Restore objectui.org docs deploy" project thread (card thread of #26993), on 2026-10-28:

- 03:24Z, on the decision card "objectui.org 文档站以后怎么处理?", Tesla chose 「B 并入 objectstack 文档站」. www.objectui.org stops being a separate site, and its docs fold into the objectstack docs site (`content/docs`, served at objectstack.ai/docs).
- 03:24Z, Tesla asked 「objectui 文档全部需要保留吗？这需要评估并和我沟通」. The card thread then sorted the 183 pages under `ui/content/docs` one by one into keep, merge, generate and delete, and put four questions to Tesla.
- 07:58Z, on that evaluation, Tesla answered 「VS Code 扩展 不会发布，其他同意」 and then 「你负责派卡执行」.

The fold is split into four cards. The first three can run in parallel; the fourth is blocked by them:
- **K1** moves the SDK pages.
- **K2** merges pages into existing ones.
- **K3** generates the component reference.
- **K4** retires the old site and adds the redirects.

This is card **K3**.

## 维护者速读

元数据作者在页面 JSON 里能用的组件,以根目录的 `sdui.manifest.json` 为准。这份清单由 CI 生成并校验,共 106 个组件,每个都带输入项的类型和说明。

objectui 站点只为其中 17 个手写了组件页,另外 89 个没有自己的组件页。本卡写一个生成脚本,从 manifest 生成 objectstack 文档站的「组件参考」,一次覆盖全部 106 个。生成之后,那 17 个手写页和组件索引页就不再需要,由 K4 删除。

生成物会有漂移检查:manifest 变了而参考页没重新生成,检查就红。

## Wanted

1. A generator script, for example `scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`, with `--self-test`. It reads `sdui.manifest.json` and writes a component reference into `content/docs`:
   - one page per namespace, or one page per component, whichever reads better at 106 entries (the dev's call, stated in the PR);
   - each component listed with its `type`, its namespace, and its inputs as a table (name, type, description);
   - a header on each generated page saying it is generated and naming the command that regenerates it.
2. The pages go in a new `content/docs/ui/components/` section, linked from `content/docs/ui/meta.json`. If the generated pages fit an existing generated area's conventions better (for example `content/docs/references/`, whose pages are never hand-edited), use that instead and say why.
3. A drift check: `--check` exits non-zero when the committed pages differ from what the manifest produces. Wire it in where `sdui.manifest.json` is already verified, so that a manifest change and its reference change land in one PR. If that wiring needs a `.github/workflows/**` edit, the PR is Tier H (draft until green, the maintainer merges); otherwise prefer a root `package.json` script that an existing check family already runs.
4. The 17 hand-written pages this replaces (`ui/content/docs/components/`): `basic/{icon,image,span,text}`, `complex/table`, `data-display/{alert,badge}`, `disclosure/accordion`, `form/{button,label}` and `layout/{box,card,container,flex,grid,stack,tabs}`, plus `components/index`. The PR body records the URL each one maps to, for K4's redirect map. Where a hand page carries a worked example the manifest lacks, put it in the PR body's Acceptance notes and do not copy it into a generated page.

⛔ Do not delete the hand pages and do not touch `ui/apps/site`. That is K4's work.

## Who acts

A `domain:devx` card thread. The surface is `scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs` (or the dev's name for it), `content/docs/ui/components/**`, `content/docs/ui/meta.json` and the root `package.json` scripts, plus the workflow line only if item 3 needs one. Serial constraint with K2: both may touch `content/docs/ui/meta.json`, so whichever lands second merges `main`.

**Business reason.** A metadata author placing a component in a page finds no page of its own for 89 of the 106 authorable components today; the inputs and their descriptions exist only inside the manifest file. A generated reference also cannot drift from the renderer the way the 17 hand pages could.

## Acceptance

- `node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs --self-test` exits 0, and `--check` exits 0 on the PR head.
- Hand-editing one generated line makes `--check` exit non-zero. Record that in the PR as a one-time ablation.
- All 106 manifest types appear in the generated pages.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build` is green.

**Duplicate search.** The same query as the fold's other cards: 33 hits, the first 10 read (#26993, #27030, #27048, #26140, #26688, #24230, #25677, #26944, #25854, #26035). No card generates docs from `sdui.manifest.json`. **New.**

**Size:** M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
